definitions.gloss: coat; fur; the lie of an animal's hair
definitions.explanation: The hair covering an animal, seen as a surface with a texture, color, and direction. Used when praising or assessing how an animal's coat looks.
A person's lineage or social background, judged as if it were an animal's coat. Almost always in {毛並|けな}みがいい, which can be admiring or faintly sarcastic depending on tone.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}の{毛並|けな}みがきれいだ。
{毛並|けな}みに{沿|そ}ってブラシをかける。
examples.english: Brush along the lie of the fur.

examples.japanese: よく{世話|せわ}をされている{馬|うま}は、{毛並|けな}みのつやが{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: A well-cared-for horse has a noticeably glossier coat.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{毛並|けな}みがいい。
examples.english: He comes from a good family.

examples.japanese: {毛並|けな}みのよさだけで{選|えら}ばれたわけではない。
examples.english: He wasn't chosen just for his pedigree.

examples.japanese: {毛並|けな}みのいい{政治家|せいじか}ばかりが{並|なら}ぶ{顔|かお}ぶれに、{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}は{冷|つめ}たかった。
examples.english: Voters were cold toward a lineup made up entirely of politicians from privileged backgrounds.

notes:
{毛|け} (hair) + {並|な}み (the way things are lined up): how the hair lies. Sense 2 extends the same image to people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毛並|けな}みがいい: to have a fine coat; to be well-born
- {毛並|けな}みが{整|ととの}う: the coat is sleek and even
- {毛並|けな}みに{沿|そ}って: along the lie of the fur

USAGE:
- Sense 2 is used of people only in the {毛並|けな}みがいい / {毛並|けな}みのいい pattern. It carries a whiff of the racehorse or show dog, so it can sound admiring or mildly mocking; it is not a neutral way to describe someone's family.
